# Migrate from Chroma Cloud to Weaviate

Start with one collection. Map your documents and embeddings, compare search results, then move your application traffic.

[Start your migration](https://weaviate.io/migrate-from-chroma#migration-tool) or [talk to our team](https://weaviate.io/migrate-from-chroma#contact-team).

## Migration steps

1. Start with one collection. Map its IDs, documents, metadata, and embeddings to Weaviate.
2. Compare search results. Run the same filtered query in both systems and check the IDs and their order.
3. Move your traffic. Redirect writes, then switch reads once your collections validate.

### Example field mapping

| Chroma Cloud | Weaviate |
| --- | --- |
| ID, such as faq-42 | UUID plus sourceId |
| Document text | body property |
| topic metadata, such as billing | topic property |
| Embedding | Object vector |

## Migrate with to-weaviate

Use the migration tool maintained by the Weaviate team to move your Chroma collections, including vectors, text, and metadata. Review a migration plan, resume interrupted copies, and verify the results against your source.

Start by configuring your Chroma and Weaviate connections using the Chroma guide. Follow its instructions for pausing source writes during the migration.

- [Read the Chroma guide](https://github.com/weaviate/to-weaviate/blob/main/docs/sources/chroma.md)
- [View on GitHub](https://github.com/weaviate/to-weaviate)
- [View on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/to-weaviate/)

### Install the migration tool

```bash
pip install to-weaviate
```

1. Inspect your Chroma collection and review the generated migration plan.
2. Check the plan, then copy your records to Weaviate.
3. Pause source writes, sync changes, and verify the copy before switching your application.

## Chroma Cloud deadlines

See [Chroma's wind-down notice](https://www.trychroma.com/cloud-wind-down) for the official dates.

### Before December 7, 2026

Redirect writes and verify that new and updated documents reach Weaviate. Chroma Cloud becomes read-only on December 7.

### Before December 22, 2026

Finish exports, validate your collections, and switch application reads before Chroma Cloud stops serving queries.

## Why teams move to Weaviate

### Hybrid search built in.

Combine vector and keyword search in one query.

### Multi-tenancy from day one.

Keep each customer's data separate as you grow.

### Open source or fully managed.

Run it yourself under BSD-3, or let us run it on Weaviate Cloud.

### Ready for production.

Replication and role-based access control, with Weaviate Cloud audited for SOC 2 Type II.

### Ask your data questions.

The Query Agent turns plain-language questions into database operations, with 1,000 free requests a month.

### Free to start.

A free Weaviate Cloud database with 100,000 objects and no credit card.

## Teams building with Weaviate

### Loti

> I need peace of mind. When we are scaling our systems, I don't want to worry about scalability and uptime of our vector database as it serves as a core foundation supporting all our services.

Dr. Hirak Chhatbar, Co-Founder and CTO. Loti reports 200+ hours saved on database maintenance and 9B vectors in production. [Read the Loti case study](https://weaviate.io/case-studies/loti).

### DocsBot

> Weaviate stood out as it’s clearly built for production use, not just testing. It was the only solution with an efficient tenant system that scaled to our workload of tens of thousands of segmented indexes.

Aaron Edwards, Founder. DocsBot reports 50K+ tenants stored in a single cluster and 6.1M+ customer questions answered. [Read the DocsBot case study](https://weaviate.io/case-studies/docsbot).

## Migration FAQ

### Do I have to re-embed my data?

Not if you keep the same embedding model. You can bring your existing vectors into Weaviate.

### Will my Chroma code work with Weaviate?

No. Weaviate has its own client libraries, including Python, TypeScript, Go and Java, so your query code will change.

### Does this affect open-source Chroma?

No. Chroma's notice only covers Chroma Cloud. If you self-host Chroma and want to move, the same steps apply.

### Can someone help us move?

Yes. Tell us about your migration and our team will help you plan it.

## Talk to our team about your migration

Planning a larger migration? Talk to our team about your workloads, requirements, and timeline.

[Contact the migration team](https://weaviate.io/migrate-from-chroma#contact-team).

---

# Weaviate authentication

Use this guide with the [official authentication documentation](https://docs.weaviate.io/deploy/configuration/authentication). Do not put credentials in source code, prompts, logs, or committed files.

## Weaviate Cloud

Weaviate Cloud (WCD) clusters are pre-configured for API-key authentication.

1. Open the cluster in the [Weaviate Cloud Console](https://console.weaviate.cloud/).
2. Open the cluster's API keys section and choose **Create an API key**.
3. Assign only the RBAC roles required by the application, then copy the key when it is shown.

Store the key in a secret manager or an environment variable. The cluster URL and key are application inputs, not values to infer:

```sh
export WEAVIATE_URL="https://your-cluster.weaviate.cloud"
export WEAVIATE_API_KEY="replace-with-a-secret"
```

The Cloud console supports editing assigned roles, rotating a key (which invalidates the old key), and deleting a key. Use rotation for planned replacement and deletion for immediate revocation. See [Cloud authentication](https://docs.weaviate.io/cloud/manage-clusters/authentication) and [Cloud authorization](https://docs.weaviate.io/cloud/manage-clusters/authorization).

## OIDC

Self-hosted Weaviate supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) when configured with an OpenID Connect Discovery-compatible issuer. API-key and OIDC authentication can be enabled together. Configure OIDC on the deployment using the documented settings in [Authentication: OIDC](https://docs.weaviate.io/deploy/configuration/authentication#oidc-authentication), including the issuer, client ID, username claim, and optional client scopes required by the identity provider.

OIDC users can be assigned Weaviate RBAC roles. The supported token flow and client behavior depend on the identity provider and SDK; follow the [OIDC configuration guide](https://docs.weaviate.io/deploy/configuration/oidc) and the SDK documentation.

**Weaviate Cloud database authentication is documented using API keys.** The official Cloud documentation does not currently describe a Weaviate-hosted delegated OAuth 2.0 consent flow. Do not infer OAuth scopes, token endpoints, manifests, or authorization flows. Self-hosted OIDC uses an external identity provider and is not a substitute for Cloud API-key authentication.

## RBAC and least privilege

Authentication identifies a user; RBAC authorizes actions. Use a separate identity or API key for each application, assign the smallest custom role that covers its required resources, and constrain permissions by collection and tenant where needed. Do not use `root` for routine application traffic. The built-in `viewer` role is read-only; custom roles and available permissions are defined in the [RBAC documentation](https://docs.weaviate.io/weaviate/configuration/rbac).

## Rotation and revocation

- Cloud: rotate or delete keys in the cluster API keys section; rotation invalidates the old key and deletion revokes it.
- Self-hosted: the user management API can create and delete users, assign and revoke roles, and rotate user API keys. See [Manage users](https://docs.weaviate.io/weaviate/configuration/rbac/manage-users).
- Replace the value in the secret manager or environment, deploy the new value, verify access, and then revoke the old credential.

## Cloud onboarding

Sign in to [Weaviate Cloud](https://console.weaviate.cloud/) and create a cluster, trial, or free product option currently offered in the console. Use the endpoint and generated API key supplied for that resource, then follow the [Cloud connection guide](https://docs.weaviate.io/cloud/manage-clusters/connect). Pricing, quotas, expiry, and available plans can change, so use the values shown in the console rather than assuming them.

## Official SDKs

These are the officially maintained SDKs listed by the [Weaviate client-library index](https://docs.weaviate.io/weaviate/client-libraries/). Registry links and installation commands are canonical:

| SDK | Registry | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Python | [PyPI: `weaviate-client`](https://pypi.org/project/weaviate-client/) | `python -m pip install -U weaviate-client` |
| TypeScript / JavaScript | [npm: `weaviate-client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/weaviate-client) | `npm install weaviate-client` |
| Go | [Go package: `github.com/weaviate/weaviate-go-client/v5`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/weaviate/weaviate-go-client/v5) | `go get github.com/weaviate/weaviate-go-client/v5` |
| Java | [Maven Central: `io.weaviate:client6`](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.weaviate/client6) | Add `io.weaviate:client6` using the current version shown in Maven Central |
| C# | [NuGet: `Weaviate.Client`](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Weaviate.Client) | `dotnet add package Weaviate.Client` |

Use the current version and authentication examples from the relevant [client-library documentation](https://docs.weaviate.io/weaviate/client-libraries/).

# 30-day Weaviate Enterprise Edition trial

# Try Weaviate Enterprise Edition for 30 days

## TL;DR

- Request a trial license key valid for 30 days for your self-hosted deployment.
- Weaviate Enterprise Edition adds features for teams running Weaviate on their own infrastructure at scale.
- Enterprise Edition is included with Weaviate Assurance, Weaviate's enterprise subscription for self-hosted teams.
- Community Edition and Enterprise Edition use the same Docker image and binary. A license key selects the edition when Weaviate starts; without a key, it runs Community Edition.
- On Weaviate v1.40 or later, activate Enterprise Edition by requesting a license key and restarting Weaviate with the key, then configure the features you want to use. No separate image or binary is needed.
- License keys apply to self-hosted deployments. Weaviate Cloud customers do not need a license key.

## Request your 30-day trial key

[Request your 30-day self-hosted trial](https://weaviate.io/enterprise-edition).

## How Enterprise Edition works

Weaviate is open source. Enterprise Edition provides additional features for larger self-hosted deployments, with a focus on security, scaling, and stability. The available feature list evolves with releases; see the [Enterprise Edition documentation](https://docs.weaviate.io/deploy/enterprise#frequently-asked-questions) for current features and activation details.

1. Use the same Weaviate image and binary as Community Edition.
2. Provide a license key when starting Weaviate to select Enterprise Edition.
3. If no license key is provided, Weaviate starts as Community Edition.
4. To upgrade an existing self-hosted deployment on v1.40 or later, obtain a key and restart Weaviate with it, then configure the Enterprise features you want to use. No separate image or binary is required.

## Deployment and subscription scope

- **Self-hosted Weaviate:** Enterprise Edition license keys are used to activate the edition on customer-managed infrastructure.
- **Weaviate Assurance:** Enterprise Edition is included with Assurance, Weaviate's enterprise subscription for self-hosted teams.
- **Weaviate Cloud:** Cloud customers do not need a license key; the license-key process is for self-hosted deployments.

## Further information

- [Enterprise Edition documentation](https://docs.weaviate.io/deploy/enterprise#frequently-asked-questions) — activation, environment variables, and the current feature list.
- [Weaviate Assurance](https://weaviate.io/product/assurance) — enterprise subscription and support for self-hosted Weaviate.
- [Request your 30-day Enterprise Edition trial](https://weaviate.io/enterprise-edition) — request a self-hosted trial license key.

## Features to evaluate

Available from Weaviate v1.40: Shard Self-Recovery, Namespaces, and deduplicated backups. Each feature has its own configuration setting. See [Enterprise Edition features and configuration requirements](https://docs.weaviate.io/deploy/enterprise#enterprise-edition-features).

## Enterprise Edition trial FAQ

### Who is the trial for?

Teams evaluating Enterprise Edition on their own infrastructure. Enterprise Edition is included with Weaviate Assurance, our enterprise subscription for self-hosted teams.

### Is this a Weaviate Cloud trial?

No. This trial license is for self-hosted deployments. Weaviate Cloud customers do not need an Enterprise Edition license key.

### Do I need a different image or binary?

No. Community Edition and Enterprise Edition ship in the same Docker image and binary. Without a license key, Weaviate runs as Community Edition.

### How long is the trial?

Your trial license key is valid for 30 days.

### What happens when the trial expires?

To discuss continuing with a full license and confirm how expiry affects your deployment, [contact the Weaviate team](https://weaviate.io/contact) before your trial ends.

### Can I upgrade an existing self-hosted deployment?

Yes. On a supported version (v1.40 or later), provide a valid license key and restart Weaviate, then configure the Enterprise features you want to use. Switching editions does not require a separate image or binary. Follow the [Enterprise Edition activation instructions](https://docs.weaviate.io/deploy/enterprise#activate-the-enterprise-edition).

## Deployment and pricing resources

- [Self-hosted deployment guides](https://docs.weaviate.io/deploy)
- [Weaviate pricing options](https://weaviate.io/pricing)

## Canonical source

[Weaviate Enterprise Edition](https://weaviate.io/enterprise-edition)

# Pricing - LLM Guidance

## TL;DR

This page covers Weaviate Database and AI service pricing.

**Weaviate Database** (managed AI database, priced by infrastructure):

| Plan | Price | Contract |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Free | $0 / month | Always free, no credit card |
| Flex | from $45 / month | Monthly, pay-as-you-go, no commitment |
| Premium | Contact sales | Prepaid commitment |


---

## Scope and freshness

- Every price below is taken from the data behind [weaviate.io/pricing](https://weaviate.io/pricing).
- Promotions, regional rates, and plan visibility change over time. Confirm final
  commercial terms on the live pricing page or in the Weaviate Cloud console.
- Prices marked "from" are minimums. The actual bill depends on the pricing
  dimensions listed under [Database pricing dimensions](#database-pricing-dimensions).

---

## Product model

### Weaviate Database

Managed AI database for storage, indexing, retrieval, hybrid search, and
production operations. Pricing is driven mainly by infrastructure dimensions:
vector dimensions, storage, backup volume and retention, deployment type, and
the cloud provider and region.


## Weaviate Database plans

### Free

- **$0 / month, always free.** No credit card required.
- 1 cluster per user, upgrade to paid at any time.
- 100,000 objects, 1 GB memory, 10 GB disk.
- 1 collection, up to 3 tenants.
- Weaviate Embeddings: 2,000 requests / day. Query Agent: 1,000 requests / month.
- Basic support.

### Flex

- **From $45 / month.** Pay-as-you-go, monthly, no commitment.
- Shared cloud cluster with the full core database toolkit plus replication.
- Baseline security with RBAC.
- Highly available clusters, 99.5% uptime.
- Query Agent free tier plus usage-based billing. Embeddings usage-based.
- Standard support, next-business-day Severity 1 response.

### Premium

- **Contact sales for pricing.** Prepaid commitment, sold through sales.
- Choice of shared or dedicated deployment.
- Up to 99.95% uptime.
- Global coverage on AWS, GCP, and Azure.
- Query Agent free tier plus usage-based billing. Embeddings usage-based.
- Enterprise support, as fast as 1-hour Severity 1 response, plus a dedicated
  Technical Account Team.

Premium is presented in two deployment flavors, Shared and Dedicated, which
differ on isolation, security controls, backup retention, SLA, and regional
coverage. The comparison tables below break both out.

---

---

## Database pricing dimensions

These are the rates that turn a plan minimum into an actual bill.

| Dimension | Free | Flex | Plus | Premium (Shared) | Premium (Dedicated) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Minimum | Free | $45 / month | $280 / month | Contact sales for more information | Contact sales for more information |
| Vector dimensions | Free | from $0.00465 / 1M | from $0.003875 / 1M | from $0.003875 / 1M | from $0.002718 / 1M |
| Storage | Free | from $0.12 / GiB | from $0.10 / GiB | from $0.10 / GiB | from $0.33 / GiB |
| Backup | Free | from $0.03036 / GiB | from $0.0042 / GiB | from $0.021 / GiB | from $0.014 / GiB |
| Data transfer | Free | Free for promotional period | Free for promotional period | Free for promotional period | Free for promotional period |

Notes:

- Vector-dimension rates are list prices and vary by cloud provider and region.
- Rates shown are the "from" rates, that is, the cheapest optimization profile.
- The September 2026 price book adds an HNSW RQ-4 rate and corrects backup pricing; the calculator currently offers HFresh Auto and HNSW RQ-8 profiles.
- Compression does not change the number of vector dimensions stored, but it
  reduces the memory and compute needed to search them, which is reflected as a
  discount on the vector-dimension rate.
- Backups are charged on top of the plan minimum, based on data volume and
  retention.

### Estimate a Database bill

The pricing page includes a calculator. Its inputs are:

- Plan (Flex or Premium, and for Premium the deployment type: shared or dedicated).
- Vector dimensions per object: 256, 384, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, 3072, 4096, or 10752.
- Number of objects: 1,000 up to 50,000,000.
- Average object size in bytes: 512 up to 8,000,000.
- Optimization profile:
  - **Cost Optimized**: HFresh index with Auto compression.
  - **Performance Optimized**: HNSW index with RQ-8 compression.

---

## Database AI services

Both services run natively inside Weaviate Cloud and are billed by usage. The
pricing page describes them as included on every plan; the AI services row of the
comparison table above is the authoritative per-plan availability, and it still
lists Embeddings as "Coming soon" on Premium (Dedicated).

### Weaviate Embeddings

Embedding models hosted in Weaviate Cloud, billed per million tokens.

| Model | Price |
| :--- | :--- |
| Snowflake arctic-embed-m-v1.5 | $0.025 / 1M tokens |
| Snowflake arctic-embed-m-v2.0 | $0.040 / 1M tokens |
| ModernVBERT ColModernVBERT | $0.065 / 1M tokens |

### Weaviate Query Agent

Turns natural-language questions into Weaviate database operations.

- Free to try: 1,000 requests / month.
- Monthly plan: **$30 per organization**, which includes 4,000 requests.
- Additional requests are unlimited and usage-based.

---

## Engram retirement

Engram is being sunset. New Engram projects can no longer be created. Existing projects will continue to work until December 31, 2026.

See [Engram documentation](https://docs.weaviate.io/engram) for existing-project information. Engram is not offered for new projects.

## Deployment options

- **Shared Cloud.** Fully managed on shared infrastructure. Available on Free,
  Flex, and Premium (Shared).
- **Dedicated Cloud.** Single-tenant managed deployment, available on Premium
  (Dedicated). Adds HIPAA compliance, AWS PrivateLink, customer-managed
  encryption keys, a 99.95% availability target, 1-hour Severity 1 response,
  45-day backup retention, and all (~40) regions across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
- **Self-hosted.** The open-source Weaviate database, run in your own
  infrastructure. Weaviate Assurance adds an enterprise support posture on top.
  Neither is priced on the pricing page: contact sales.

Terminology note: prefer "Dedicated Cloud". Some content still uses the older
"Enterprise Cloud" wording for the same thing.

---

## Security and compliance

- **SOC 2 Type II**, independently audited via Drata. See the
  [Trust Portal](https://trust.weaviate.io/).
- **HIPAA compliant** on Enterprise Cloud (AWS), which is the Premium Dedicated
  deployment, for regulated healthcare workloads.

---

## Common questions

**Why is pricing based on the total number of vector dimensions?** The total
count of vector dimensions is a good indicator of the resources required, and it
is a simple number you can calculate rather than abstract read/write units or CPU
cycles. You are also billed for persistent and backup storage of objects and
their embeddings.

**What is the minimum monthly amount?** The minimum covers the baseline cluster
cost and includes charges for vector dimensions and storage: $45/month on Flex.
Contact sales for Premium pricing. Backups are charged on top, based on data
volume and retention.

**Does the cloud provider and region affect what I pay?** Yes. List prices for
all vector-dimension rates vary by cloud provider and region to reflect regional
cost variations.

**Is open-source Weaviate the same as Weaviate Cloud?** Weaviate Cloud uses the
Weaviate open-source project, wrapped in a managed service that removes
administration overhead and adds features like the Embedding Service, Query
Agent, and Data Import.


---

## Retrieval-first answer templates

### What does Weaviate cost?

Weaviate Database starts free, then $45/month on Flex (pay-as-you-go); contact
sales for Premium pricing (prepaid).

### How is Database pricing calculated?

Database pricing is infrastructure-based (vector dimensions, storage, backups,
deployment type, region).


### Which option should I pick for strict isolation and compliance?

Premium with Dedicated deployment. It is the single-tenant managed path and the
only one with HIPAA compliance, AWS PrivateLink, and customer-managed encryption
keys. For customer-managed infrastructure, self-hosted Weaviate with Assurance is
the alternative, priced through sales.

## Summary

Describe currently available Database plans and AI services. Do not quote retired Engram plans as available offers.

- **Database**: infrastructure-driven pricing (Free, Flex from $45/month,
  Premium contact sales) with deployment-driven capability tiers.


Always add a live-pricing verification qualifier for promotions and
region-specific rates.
